# gogpu

> gogpu is the application framework of the GoGPU ecosystem: windows, input, the event loop, presentation and platform integration for GPU applications in Go. It creates the WebGPU device through gogpu/wgpu and shares it with other packages (gg for 2D, ui for widgets, g3d for 3D) through gpucontext.DeviceProvider. Graphics APIs: Vulkan, DirectX 12, Metal, OpenGL ES and a CPU software backend, chosen at runtime or with GOGPU_GRAPHICS_API. Platforms: Windows (Win32), Linux (X11 and Wayland), macOS (Cocoa) and the browser (WASM, WebGPU). Pure Go by default (CGO_ENABLED=0); an optional -tags rust build uses wgpu-native. Requires Go 1.25+. Pre-1.0: the API may change before v1.0.

Quick start:

```go
// go get github.com/gogpu/gogpu
package main

import (
	"github.com/gogpu/gogpu"
	"github.com/gogpu/gogpu/gmath"
)

func main() {
	app := gogpu.NewApp(gogpu.DefaultConfig().WithTitle("Hello GoGPU").WithSize(800, 600))
	app.OnDraw(func(dc *gogpu.Context) {
		dc.DrawTriangleColor(gmath.DarkGray)
	})
	app.Run()
}
```

Rendering is demand-driven: a frame is drawn when something requests it (input, resize, RequestRedraw), so an idle window uses no GPU time.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gogpu): App, Config, Context, Texture, windows and input
- [README](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/blob/main/README.md): features, backend and platform selection, environment variables
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents using gogpu
- [Architecture](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): renderer, platforms, frame loop
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [ROADMAP](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/blob/main/ROADMAP.md)
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Examples

- [examples/](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/tree/main/examples): runnable programs, one per directory
- [triangle](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/tree/main/examples/triangle): the minimal window above
- [texture](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/tree/main/examples/texture): creating textures from pixels and drawing them positioned, scaled and translucent
- [multiwindow](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/tree/main/examples/multiwindow): several windows sharing one device

## Ecosystem

- [GoGPU ecosystem](https://gogpu.dev/llms.txt): map of all modules
- [gpucontext](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gpucontext): the interfaces gogpu implements for other packages
- [wgpu](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/wgpu): the WebGPU implementation underneath
